1 · Intro

When to use it.

Use Change Salary for off-cycle salary changes: retention, reclass, market, counteroffer, equity, or an FTE change.

Start from the Quick Action, or search the employee's name and open the action from their record. Both reach the same screen.

Use this whenA salary changes outside the annual increase process.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Reasons you'll use most
ReasonWhen
RetentionKeeping a flight risk. The most common outside annual increases.
ReclassRole reclassification. Also common.
MarketPay adjusted to market. Less common.
Counteroffer, EquityAs named.
Central HR updateCatch-all that needs documentation. Used for an FTE drop, such as 1.0 to 0.75 for an accommodation.
Exempt / non-exempt changeStatus change in either direction.

Watch-outs

  • Annual increases and union requests have their own reasons. Don't use them for off-cycle changes.
  • Direct-hire reasons (no requisition) appear in the list. Ignore them here.
  • Oracle needs little in comments and attachments, but many departmental finance approvers want more. Confirm what your finance partner expects before you submit.
  • Exempt (monthly) payroll cutoff is around the 18th, usually the 15th to 18th, and earlier in December. The payroll calendar is the source of truth.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Redwood Change Salary page fields (25C) (opens in a new tab)
  • Oracle: Overview of Document Records (opens in a new tab)

HCM Academy job aid · Compensation Management

Change salary

Use when: A salary changes outside the annual increase process. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Start the transaction.
    • Quick Actions > Change Salary > select the employee, or
    • Search the employee's name > Change Salary.
  2. Effective date: when the new salary starts (for example, Nov 1).
  3. Action: Change salary. Pick the reason.
  4. Click Continue.
  5. Enter the new salary.
    • A new amount (for example, $85,000), or
    • A percentage increase (for example, 2%).
  6. Review, then click Continue.
  7. Attach supporting documents to the personnel record.
  8. Add comments and any transaction attachments. Click Submit.

  • Direct-hire reasons (no requisition) appear in the list. Ignore them here.
  • Oracle needs little in comments and attachments, but many departmental finance approvers want more. Confirm what your finance partner expects before you submit.
  • Exempt (monthly) payroll cutoff is around the 18th, usually the 15th to 18th, and earlier in December. The payroll calendar is the source of truth.
